reason: Address Greptile follow-up on npm store safety, local read behavior, package risk scoring, and custom registry intelligence behavior.

changes.summary: Whitelist domain tables before constructing ListIDs table queries and fix last_week upsert value ordering.
Open existing local stores with OpenReadOnly for local read paths.

Return npm downloads lookup failures instead of silently dropping them, surface npm deprecation metadata in package risk scoring, and skip public download lookups for non-default registries unless a downloads API override is configured.
Add regressions for last_week versions_id storage and ListIDs fallback behavior with untrusted resource names.
Add regressions for package summary download lookup errors, deprecated-package risk signals, and custom-registry package summaries without public download counts.
